language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and grasps the wooden spoon in frames 51–74 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image), then visibly lifts and carries it toward the open drawer in frames 80–143 (image, left_ego_image). In frames 149–156, wrist_image shows the fingers opening and the spoon settling inside the drawer; frames 157–171 show the empty gripper withdrawing while the spoon remains in the drawer. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
